EGY.note: The document covers a property identifier, not authentication of people.
Nothing on links between civil register and ID system.
Gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.
Nothing on ID numbers given at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the national ID system.
The property number is not a register keyed on the national ID number.
Nothing on the national ID system itself; the property number is not a person ID.
